## TemplateEngine.\_compileFilterChain() method

Applies `|filter:arg` pipes to an already-resolved head expression.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _compileFilterChain(access: string, expr: string, warned: Set<string>): string;
```

## Remarks

Split out of [TemplateEngine.\_processScopeVariables()](./gramstax.templateengine._processscopevariables.md) so `<g-map>` can run the same whitelist over its own loop variables instead of re-deriving the pipe grammar. The caller resolves the head — a `data` path or a loop variable — and passes the whole expression; the leading segment is dropped because it is already baked into `access`<!-- -->.
